svg.text: 1 Selected (keyboard focus): a 2 px accent ring on the light accent fill. ↑ ↓ move it, Enter opens, as a link: a
middle-click or ⌘-click opens the item page in a new tab. Back in the browser returns to the list with that row selected.
2 Paging: the next page loads when the footer scrolls into view; the footer is also a Load more button, so a
keyboard can reach it. While it loads: a spinner and 'Loading more…'. At the end: '128 issues' in grey.
3 The filters and the sort are in the URL (#/work/issues?project=…&label=…&sort=…), so a link or a reload keeps them.
Hover (row 3): the hover colour. Board ▾ is here (Mac + web). A wide page is anything over 700 px.
